method: Sequential BenchmarkDotNet Short runs on the dedicated quiet VM. Two original 513x259 rasters at depths 8/16. Warm public flip includes allocation/disposal; paired batches read/write 32 exact repeats in one process per subject. Three measured iterations per case; preliminary narrow scope, no local timings.
